SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_LOCAL_TIP: This mod was installed locally and contains no Steam Workshop information
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_SAME_ID_TIP: Another copy of this mod is installed with the same ID: {others}
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_NEW_TIP: This mod was recently added, and requires a relaunch to be loaded
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_COSMETIC_TIP: This mod changes game art, such as character and card reskins, backgrounds, battle animations, or sound effects and music
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_STABLE_TIP: This mod is listed for the stable branch (public) only. On beta, it loads with an error, and may not work.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_BETA_TIP: This mod is listed for the beta branch (public-beta) only. On stable, it loads with an error, and may not work.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.ALIAS_HINT: An alternative title for the mod
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SETTINGS_FAILED_TIP: This mod's settings didn't open. The game's log says why.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NO_SETTINGS_TIP: No settings were found for this mod
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.AUTHOR: Author
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_LOADS_AFTER: Loads on relaunch, in place of {other}
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_LOSES: {other} will be used due to {why} - disable copies you don't want to use
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_LOSES_PLAIN: {other} will be used instead - disable copies you don't want to use
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_WHY_FIRST: matching version numbers and an earlier install date
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_BLOCKED: This copy would load before a required dependency. {other} is currently compatible and will be loaded instead.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_LOADS_BLOCKED: The copy {other} would load before a required dependency, so this copy will be loaded instead
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_LOADS_ALSO: {other} is also enabled - only this copy will be loaded
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_FAILED_OTHER: This mod shares an ID with {other}
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_NOT_APPLIED: Spire Mod Manager couldn't choose which copy was loaded. If the game is on a different version, Spire Mod Manager may need to be updated.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.ERROR_MIN_VERSION_INVA: Mod {id} depends on mod {dependency} with min version {minVersion}, which couldn't be read
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.OTHERS_PARKED: {count} more from other mods: see the vanilla modding page
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.GAME_CAPTION_OFF: Error while loading - Can be ignored if disabled
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MODIFIED_CODE_TIP: This mod changes game code in {places}. Modifications relate to these areas of the game, and additional changes not listed here may still be present.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MODIFIED_BOTH_TIP: This mod changes game code in {places}, and replaces {files}. Modifications relate to these areas of the game, and additional changes not listed here may still be present.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MODIFIED_FILES_TIP: This mod replaces {count} game files, relating to these areas. There may still be additional content not described here.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MODIFIED_FILES_TIP_ONE: This mod replaces 1 game file, relating to these areas. There may still be additional content not described here.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MODIFIED_NONE_TIP: The type of content this mod affects couldn't be identified
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MODIFIED_NOT_LOADED: This mod's contents can only be identified while it's loaded
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MODIFIED_NOTE: This is a list of game elements expected to be adjusted by this mod. Some changes are declared internally by the mod, and others are inferred from the location of changes in game code. The list may not be fully accurate, and other areas of the game not listed here may still be affected.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.PATCH_KINDS_INTRO: Listed are the locations of changes to code, and whether they run before, after, or in place of existing code
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.PATCH_KINDS:
Before: the mod's code runs before the game's code, and can optionally skip it
After: runs after the game's code, even if it was skipped
Rewrite: the game code itself was adjusted or rewritten by the mod
Final: runs after the previous stages, even if one of them failed
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_CUSTOM_COUNT_TIP: Your custom tag, applied to {count} mods
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_CUSTOM_COUNT_TIP_O: Your custom tag, applied to 1 mod

SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NEW_COPY_OFF_BODY: A copy of {mods} was recently installed, and is disabled
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LAUNCH_FAILED_TITLE: The last launch stopped before the main menu
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_GAME_CHANGED: The game itself was updated since then, so the old setup may still not launch
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_CODE: [gold]{mod}[/gold] stopped the game from starting. The error came from its code.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_PATCH: [gold]{mod}[/gold] most likely stopped the game from starting. The error came from a part of the game it changes.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_LIBRARY_: [gold]{mod}[/gold] most likely stopped the game from starting. The error came from [gold]{library}[/gold], which it needs, and it's new or updated since the last working launch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_TYPES: [gold]{mod}[/gold] most likely stopped the game from starting. Part of its code couldn't be loaded, as happens with a mod made for another version of the game.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_CLASH: [gold]{mod}[/gold] most likely stopped the game from starting. It adds something with the same ID as [gold]{other}[/gold] does ({id}), and it's new or updated since the last working launch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_REBUILD: [gold]{mod}[/gold] most likely stopped the game from starting. The error came while mods' changes to a part of the game were being put in place, and it's the one of them that's new or updated since the last working launch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_REBUILD_: [gold]{mod}[/gold] most likely stopped the game from starting. The error came while its changes to a part of the game were being put in place, and that part was fine without them.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_STALE: [gold]{mod}[/gold] stopped the game from starting. Part of its code can't run on this version of the game, as happens after a game update.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_STALE_MA:
These mods stopped the game from starting. Part of each one's code can't run on this version of the game, as happens after a game update:
{mods}
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_DOCTOR: Mod Doctor found that [gold]{mod}[/gold] stopped the game from starting.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_UPDATED: [gold]{mod}[/gold] was updated since the last working launch ({date}), from {from} to {to}. It most likely stopped the game from starting.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_UPDATED_:
These mods were updated since the last working launch ({date}). One of them most likely stopped the game from starting:
{mods}
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_TURN_OFF_BODY: Spire Mod Manager can turn off [gold]{mod}[/gold] and restart the game. It stays installed, and you can turn it back on later.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_TURN_OFF_BODY_MA: Spire Mod Manager can turn them off and restart the game. They stay installed, and you can turn them back on later.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_TURN_OFF_NEEDS: The mods that need it are turned off too: {mods}.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_ALREADY_OFF: Turned off after the last failed start: {mods}.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_STREAK: The game failed to start {count} times in a row. If a game update broke many mods, you can turn them all off, then turn them back on a few at a time.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_DIDNT_STICK: Spire Mod Manager turned off [gold]{mod}[/gold] after the last failed start, but the same copy loaded again. Something put the game's settings back, such as another mod or program.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_CULPRIT_SELF: The error came from Spire Mod Manager itself.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_TURN_OFF_SELF_BO: It can turn itself off and restart the game. To use it again, enable it on the vanilla modding page.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_SELF_NEEDED: These mods need it and won't load until it's on again: {mods}. They stay as they are, so turning Spire Mod Manager back on brings them back.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_SAVE_FAILED: Spire Mod Manager couldn't turn off [gold]{mod}[/gold]: the game couldn't save its settings, so nothing was changed. Check that settings.save in the game's user folder isn't read-only, or remove the mod by hand: unsubscribe from it on the Workshop, or move it out of the game's mods folder.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_RECORD_FAILED: Spire Mod Manager couldn't turn off [gold]{mod}[/gold]: it couldn't save its note of the change, so nothing was changed. Check that the game's mod_data folder isn't read-only, or remove the mod by hand: unsubscribe from it on the Workshop, or move it out of the game's mods folder.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_RECORD_FAILED_OF: Spire Mod Manager turned off [gold]{mod}[/gold] but couldn't save its note of the change, or turn it back on, so it may stay off. To turn it back on, use the game's mod settings. Check that the game's mod_data folder isn't read-only.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_RESTORE_FAILED: Spire Mod Manager couldn't restore the last working setup: the game couldn't save its settings, so the mod list wasn't changed. Check that settings.save in the game's user folder isn't read-only.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_RESTART_FAILED: [gold]{mod}[/gold] is turned off, but the game couldn't restart itself. Quit, then start the game again.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_RESTORE_OR:
Or restore the setup of the last working launch ({date}). What changed since then:
{changes}
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_TURN_OFF_SELF: Turn off Spire Mod Manager and restart
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_ALL_OFF: Turn off all mods and restart
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_BODY: [gold]{mod}[/gold] stopped the game from starting on {date}, so Spire Mod Manager turned it off. It stays installed and off until you turn it back on.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_BODY_LIKELY: [gold]{mod}[/gold] most likely stopped the game from starting on {date}, so Spire Mod Manager turned it off. It stays installed and off until you turn it back on.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_BODY_SUSPEC: Spire Mod Manager turned off [gold]{mod}[/gold] on {date}, after the game failed to start: Mod Doctor suspected it. It stays installed and off until you turn it back on.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_BODY_MANY:
Spire Mod Manager turned these mods off after the game failed to start. They stay installed and off until you turn them back on:
{mods}
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_WITH: The mods that need it were turned off with it: {mods}.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_UPDATED: It has been updated since ({from} → {to}), so it may work now.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_SAME_ERROR: The same error came back after [gold]{mod}[/gold] was turned off, so it most likely wasn't the cause.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_ON_FAILED: Couldn't turn [gold]{mod}[/gold] back on: the game couldn't save its settings. Check that settings.save in the game's user folder isn't read-only.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_ON_NONE: Couldn't turn [gold]{mod}[/gold] back on: there's no installed copy to turn on.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_ON_NO_STEAM: Couldn't turn [gold]{mod}[/gold] back on: Workshop mods are only listed while Steam is running.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_BANNER: {mod} was turned off after a failed start
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_BANNER_MANY: {count} mods were turned off after a failed start
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_CARD_TITLE: Turned off after a failed start
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_ON_TIP: Turn them back on. They load after a relaunch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TURNED_OFF_DISMISS_TIP: Hide this. The mods stay off.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_RECOVERED:
The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read.

Backup from {date} was loaded instead.

The unreadable file can be found in the [url=folder]Spire Mod Manager's data folder[/url] as:
"{file}"
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_FROM_BMM:
The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read.

No backup was found, so your groups, notes and profiles were imported again from Better Mod Menu.

The unreadable file can be found in the [url=folder]Spire Mod Manager's data folder[/url] as:
"{file}"
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_FRESH:
The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read.

No backup was found so an empty profile will be created.

The unreadable file can be found in the [url=folder]Spire Mod Manager's data folder[/url] as:
"{file}"
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_READ_ONLY:
Changes this session won't be saved.

The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read or moved.
If the file is currently in use by another program, that program may need to be closed.

You can find the file in the [url=folder]Spire Mod Manager's data folder[/url] as:
"{file}"

Relaunch the game and try again.

SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_NO_MODS: This list has no mods in it
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_CHANGES: Changes compared to the current profile:

SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_WARNING: This profile contains {count} mods that aren't installed
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_WARNING_ONE: This profile contains 1 mod that isn't installed
